description: This line plot compares the BLEU scores for two decoding strategies—“Consistency: wait-1” and “Inconsistency: wait-9”—under a prefix-constrained decoding setting, with the x-axis representing “the length of gold prefix” ranging from 0 to 20 tokens on a linear scale. The y-axis represents BLEU score, ranging from 23 to 29, also on a linear scale. The “Consistency: wait-1” strategy is depicted by a blue dashed line with circle markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 24.5 at x=0, dipping to about 23.8 at x=2, then rising steadily to reach approximately 28.0 at x=20. The “Inconsistency: wait-9” strategy is shown by an orange solid line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 25.2 at x=0, fluctuating around the 25.0 to 26.0 range, and ending at approximately 25.8 at x=20. The plot indicates that the consistency strategy generally achieves higher BLEU scores than the inconsistency strategy across the tested prefix lengths.
